Ava (AE): Kickoff: Acme Bank POC — we need to finalize the acceptance matrix and eval harness today. High-level asks: 1) prioritized use cases, 2) golden prompts + seed examples, 3) scoring rubric & regression gates, 4) infra choice (hosted vs dedicated) and timeline. @Jamal @Priya @Elena please chime in with constraints and estimates :eyes:
Jamal (SE): From the runtime side: we need target throughput (qps) and latency SLOs to pick config. Can you confirm peak concurrent requests? Also call out max sequence length per request — if >1024 we should plan for memory headroom. For Acme, assume p95 < 350ms and burst to 60 qps. Dedicated GPU pool preferred for stable throughput.
Tom (Acme Contact): Quick clarifier — 60 qps peak sounds right for our demo, but we can cap to 30 for the POC. Timeline: demo in 3 weeks, integration in 6.
Priya (Solutions Eng): For the eval harness I recommend a two-stage approach: automated metrics + human review. Golden dataset: aim for 200 samples total split across 4 intents (50 each). Seed examples should include edge cases, ambiguous phrasing, and malicious inputs. Scoring: automated extraction F1 where applicable, EM for exact outputs, logits-based confidence thresholding, plus human 1-5 rating for hallucination/clarity. Regression gate: if automated pass rate drops >2 percentage points vs baseline OR human average rating drops >=0.3, fail the rollout.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Example prompt template we expect teams to provide (please paste into harness):
```
SYSTEM: You are an assistant summarizer for bank forms.
USER: <document text>
ASSISTANT: <structured summary JSON with fields: account_type, action_items, risk_flags>
```
This yields structured scoring (schema match + field-level F1).
Elena (Security): Security checklist: data residency: keep all PII in customer VPC. KMS integration required for key management. Audit logs forwarded to Acme SIEM. Need answers to their questionnaire: encryption RTT, role-based access, least-privilege ACL examples. Also confirm whether dedicated nodes will be in their VPC or our managed private tenancy.
Marta (Sales Ops): Pricing question from Tom earlier — for a 3-week POC on dedicated (reserved 8xA100 equivalent) we typically estimate a short-term commit plus usage overage. I'll draft a ballpark estimate and attach in the follow-up. For the demo we can leverage a reduced commit (trial discount) — I’ll confirm numbers by EOD.
Jamal (SE): Technical notes for the harness: please provide representative payloads (json) and 20k tokens/day estimate so we can size KV cache and batching. Also indicate whether function/tool-calls are used (they affect latency). For the model: recommend testing two tiers — 13B quantized (cost-efficient) and 70B float or quant-pt for quality comparison.
Tom (Acme Contact): We'll provide 200 golden examples and 50 adversarial cases. Also sending the security questionnaire PDF now.
infra-bot: environment provisioned -> redwood-acme-poc-dedicated-useast1-01, creds emailed to infra-contacts. Note: DNS and firewall will need Acme IP allowlist.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Acceptance matrix draft (short):
- Use case A (form extraction): automated field-level F1 >= 0.88 AND human avg >=4.0
- Use case B (policy reply suggestions): response relevance >=0.80 (BLEU/ROUGE proxy) AND latency p95 <= 350ms
- Safety gate: zero high-severity hallucinations in a 200-sample audit (human)
- Regression gate: as above (>=2pp drop in automated pass rate OR >=0.3 drop human avg)
If all pass, move to canary with 10% traffic; otherwise rollback to fallback model.
Ava (AE): Great — action items: 1) Tom to share golden set + sample payloads (today), 2) Priya to upload harness config and rubric (EOD), 3) Elena to mark questionnaire gaps (EOD), 4) Marta to send pricing estimate (EOD), 5) Jamal to confirm infra sizing (tomorrow morning).
Tom (Acme Contact): ✅ will share files in email now. Thanks everyone.
Elena (Security): One more ask — please redact account numbers in golden set or send via secure upload.
Marta (Sales Ops): I'll include two pricing lines in the estimate (hosted vs dedicated) and list the delta for reserved commit.
Jamal (SE): I'll start a quick perf test plan once sample payloads are in. Prefers nightly batch runs for the 3-week window.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll post the harness repo link and a short runbook once it's staged. Expect a simple `python run_eval.py --golden golden.json --model model-id` flow.
Ava (AE): Perfect — we're aligned. Follow-ups in-thread or DM for blockers. :thumbsup:
